The Acoustical Society of China has launched the third Shenghua Cup Acoustic Technology Competition, sponsored by Hangzhou Zhaohua Electronics Co., Ltd. It aims to support students of acoustics and related fields with a low-barrier yet serious hardware platform, encourage innovation from code to hardware, and find rising talent who combine theoretical depth with engineering skill. The theme is a play on words that roughly means “Smart minds for acoustic imaging: a new generation gets hands-on with hardware.”

It is open to full-time undergraduate, master’s and doctoral students in China. Teams of one to three students, with a designated leader, must each have a faculty advisor; advisors may lead one team and students may enter one task. There are two tasks: a high-dynamic-range algorithm for identifying multiple sound sources, and an algorithm that optimizes the minimum sound pressure level that can be imaged in a noisy environment. Twelve prizes are planned across both tasks: two first prizes of 30,000 yuan per team (before tax), four second prizes of 20,000 yuan and six third prizes of 10,000 yuan. Certificates will be presented at the opening ceremony of the 2025 National Acoustics Conference, and outstanding students will get priority for internships and jobs with the sponsor.

Teams register on the competition website by uploading a signed team information form; the committee reviews entries within three working days, then contacts approved teams on WeChat with the task files. The schedule, task details and FAQ appear as images in the original notice.

This notice was issued by the Secretariat of the Acoustical Society of China and reposted by Ziyu Acoustics. Competition website (in Chinese).
